    sd.sql(f"CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW raster_table AS SELECT RS_FromPath('{raster_cea_tif}') AS raster").execute()

    # Rasterize the convex hull of the raster onto its own grid
    # RS_AsRaster(geometry, reference_raster, pixel_type, all_touched, burn_value, nodata_value, use_geometry_extent)
    query = """
    SELECT RS_Width(
      RS_AsRaster(
        RS_ConvexHull(raster),
        raster,
        'float64',
        false,
        1.0,
        0.0,
        false
      )
    ) as width
    FROM raster_table
    """

    table = sd.sql(query).to_arrow_table()
    width = table.column("width")[0].as_py()

    # The width of the rasterized convex hull should match the width of the original raster
    # because we used the original raster as the reference grid.
    original_width = sd.sql("SELECT RS_Width(raster) FROM raster_table").to_arrow_table().column(0)[0].as_py()

    assert width == original_width, f"Expected width {original_width}, got {width}"

    print(f"__CHECK__ sql:RS_AsRaster {width}")
